about: StepTimers' duration words. patterns: case-insensitive regex fragments, matched as whole words after a number; seconds is how long one of that unit lasts. A smaller unit straight after a larger one continues the duration ('1 hour 30 minutes'). followOn: regex fragments that may join the two parts ('2 minutes and 30 seconds'). label: how a timer button writes the unit ('1 hr 30 min').
